_comment: Primitives TestServer commons bug-list.json (design 'Bug Configuration'): the
authoritative ledger of known bugs across the Primitives Language_Servers,
a 'bugs' object keyed by bug id, each { description, ticketId }. A server
declares the ids it currently exhibits in its own bug-config.json (a flat
array); every such id MUST be defined here. Empty: no known bugs.
